description: D Gukesh produced a crucial comeback win over Germany’s Alexander Donchenko in Round 9, helping India stay in the Chess Olympiad gold medal race. India’s men beat Germany 2.5-1.5, while Vantika Agrawal and Divya Deshmukh powered the women’s team to victory. India’s men trail Uzbekistan, while the women remain second behind leaders China with two rounds left.

title: Pakistan goes bananas over giant gorillas dancing to Bollywood songs
description: In Lahore, a vibrant new trend has emerged where massive gorillas are stealing the spotlight at weddings and celebrations. The concept, launched by Shayen Zahoor after receiving a gorilla costume in April, quickly captured attention on Instagram, amassing over a million views in just two days. This phenomenon led to a surge in event bookings, making these giant gorillas a delightful and unmistakable presence at gatherings across Pakistan.

title: CBSE names Mandeep K Bhandari as new chairman, appointment follows OSM controversy
description: The Central Board of Secondary Education has appointed 2001-batch IAS officer Mandeep K Bhandari as its new chairman. His appointment comes months after the board faced scrutiny over the implementation of its On-Screen Marking system for Class 12 evaluation. Bhandari brings extensive administrative experience from Jammu and Kashmir and the Centre as CBSE prepares for its next examination cycle.

title: San Antonio oyster shells recycled to rebuild Gulf reefs and marine habitat
description: Discarded oyster shells from San Antonio restaurants and events are being recycled to restore oyster reefs in the Gulf of Mexico. The South Texas Coastal Initiative sends collected shells to the Sink Your Shucks program, where they are reused for reef restoration. With about 100,000 oysters consumed during Fiesta Oyster Bake weekend, organizers are seeking $150,000 annually.

description: In his maiden address to UN General Assembly, Shah, 36, said, “Glaciers and floods do not travel with a visa stamped on passports.” His address on Thursday came during his first foreign trip since taking office on March 27.

title: India is kicking car safety into top gear with Bharat NCAP 2.0: What you need to know
description: Bharat NCAP is set to evolve with its second phase, Bharat NCAP 2.0, planned for October 2027. This revised framework will assess vehicle safety across multiple stages, including crash avoidance and post-collision care. The new system promises to go beyond just occupant protection to include vulnerable road users as well. Adult and child occupant protection will remain critical components of the evaluation process.

title: Mumbai prime home prices rise 6.2%, enter global top 10
description: In a striking development, Mumbai has surged into the world’s top 10 residential markets, landing at eighth place with a notable 6.2% annual price gain. Bengaluru and New Delhi aren't far behind, securing the 12th and 17th spots. While global prices ticked up by only 2.6%, Mumbai's luxury segment stands resilient, fueled by high demand and limited housing options in prime locales.

title: Massive fire at Delhi building housing Haldiram’s outlet; 30 rescued
description: A fire broke out in a three-storey building in northwest Delhi's Model Town area. The incident occurred around 2pm, with thick smoke seen billowing from the building. After a swift police response, around 30 people were safely evacuated from the premises. The Delhi fire service deployed 23 units to control the medium fire, which started due to a suspected short circuit.

title: Asian Games: India win six medals, including shooting gold, as Baranica makes history
description: During a thrilling day at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, India brought home six medals, showcasing its athletic prowess. Baranica Elangovan made waves as she bagged a bronze medal in women's pole vault, a historic first for the nation. In shooting, Suruchi Singh and Kamaljeet delivered a sensational performance, earning gold and ending a lengthy wait for that accolade.

Nebraska couple lost $59,759 home over $588 tax debt; compensation claim revived
description: A Nebraska couple, Kevin Fair and Terry Fair, lost their home due to unpaid property taxes totaling $588. After being unable to pay the amount required to redeem their property, Continental Resources obtained a tax deed. Fair claimed that losing property worth $59,759 for such a small tax debt constituted an unconstitutional taking. The Nebraska Supreme Court ruled Fair had a valid takings claim based on property value.

title: Baranica Elangovan wins India's first-ever pole vault medal at Asian Games
description: The 29-year-old secured the bronze with a best clearance of 4.15m. She shared the medal with Kazakhstan's Polina Ivanova, who also cleared 4.15m. The two athletes matched each other on countback, resulting in a shared bronze.

description: Donald Trump told Xi Jinping that any assistance China provides to Iran is unacceptable during his visit. The two leaders held a closed-door meeting to discuss various critical global issues, including trade and military matters. Trump organized a state dinner attended by key US technology executives to enhance relations. The visit coincided with China's Mid-Autumn Festival, marking a time for family gatherings and festivities.

title: Called ‘black-complexioned’ and ‘fatty-shaped’: Why man’s divorce plea failed
description: A husband in Chhattisgarh appealed for divorce from his wife due to claims of cruelty and desertion. The high court examined the evidence and found the husband's allegations lacked proof. The court noted that inappropriate comments alone did not justify granting a divorce. Additionally, the wife provided counterclaims against her husband’s behavior and care. Consequently, the court upheld the family court's decision and dismissed the divorce appeal.

This content allegedly associates her with Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a protest by the Cockroach Janta Party. The court issued notices to the Delhi Police and CJP leaders following an urgent plea. Furthermore, the court ordered police protection for the woman, who has faced threats.

title: The Backstory: When 'Tau' Devi Lal won the PM race, and then gave it away
description: Emerging as a pivotal political leader during the 1989 governmental shift in India, Chaudhary Devi Lal first captured the deputy Prime Minister position via astute maneuvering within the Janata Dal party. His major influence was rooted in unwavering backing from Haryana's agricultural sector. Yet, infighting ultimately led to the VP Singh government's downfall.

title: Georgia landowner claimed $23m tax break; court backs $480,000 valuation
description: A Georgia landowner claimed a $23 million charitable tax deduction after donating a 103-acre conservation easement, arguing the property could have been used as an aggregate quarry. The US Tax Court rejected the proposed quarry use, valuing the easement at $480,000. The 11th Circuit upheld the valuation and a 40% gross valuation misstatement penalty.

title: Zuckerberg’s $300m superyacht docks in Japan, gets neighbour who once wanted Meta out
description: Mark Zuckerberg's impressive superyacht, Launchpad, has recently anchored in Japan, right beside Yusaku Maezawa's Nausicaä. Their close proximity underscores an ongoing legal dispute as Maezawa pursues Meta for the misuse of his name in deceptive investment advertising. Even without plans to meet, their vessels symbolize the intense rivalry. After a summer in Alaska, Launchpad is set to chart its course towards Singapore, making this encounter noteworthy.

title: Travis and Jason Kelce’s $200M brand hits new milestone amid revenue growth
description: Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce’s successful venture, Garage Beer, has received a new investment amid the star player's record breaking performance.

title: California used 662,700 waste tires under I-880 ramp; no issues in 22 years
description: Engineers faced challenges while upgrading a highway interchange in Milpitas due to unstable bay mud. They opted to use shredded waste tires as lightweight fill to prevent ground settlement. This choice reduced weight on the soft soil by 40 percent and saved significant project costs. Over two decades, the infrastructure has shown no maintenance issues or structural damage.

title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific ocean conservation
description: The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Alonzo Mourning’s $37.4M housing project offers seniors apartments from $322
description: After his NBA career, Alonzo Mourning founded AM Affordable Housing to address the pressing need for affordable homes in South Florida. Through collaboration with Housing Trust Group, he has spearheaded various projects, including the Astoria on 9th, which boasts 120 affordable apartments in Bradenton. With overwhelming demand and countless applicants vying for limited options, Mourning draws on his foster care history to fuel his philanthropic mission.
